posts.hook: Zuckerberg just told the AI industry: evaluate, don't slow down.
posts.caption: zuckerberg says ai labs should train safely, not slow down, as sanders and bannon share a stage demanding tighter ai rules and cybersecurity experts call the industry's apocalypse warnings incoherent. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Zuckerberg picks evaluators over an AI slowdown
slides.desc: Says every lab has "responsibility and incentive" to train safely; Meta delayed Muse for it.

slides.title: OpenAI in early talks on a $1.2T pre-IPO round
slides.desc: Same week OpenRouter spend flipped to OpenAI over Anthropic for the first time since 2024.

slides.title: Sanders and Bannon share a stage to demand AI limits
slides.desc: Cross-partisan assembly in DC, the same week a poll found 61% oppose AI data centers.

slides.title: Experts call AI leaders' hacking warnings incoherent
slides.desc: Cybersecurity pros tell NBC the apocalyptic framing misreads the actual technical risk.

slides.title: Researchers took over Baseten's production GitHub
slides.desc: A leaked access token gave admin access to the AI infra company's org, disclosed publicly.

slides.title: Perplexity dumped DynamoDB for its own CobbleDB
slides.desc: Two engineers built it with coding agents; storage latency down 82%, cost down 20%.
